local.h: NY Public Radio CEO steps down after 8 months
local.b: Christy Tanner, who took over New York Public Radio in February, is stepping down. The organization gave no reason.

local.h: Cyclist killed by ambulance on Staten Island
local.b: A cyclist riding the wrong way on Richmond Ave in Bulls Head was fatally struck by a turning ambulance Monday night, the NYPD said. The ambulance was not carrying a patient.
local.title: Cyclist dies in wrong-way crash with an ambulance on Staten Island

local.h: Hochul, Blakeman meet in lone governor debate
